title: Validation finding, version 2
description: One defect, spec gap or integration gap as the validation subsystem reports it up the chain. Version 2 adds the fields a program (the Frontend's feedback agent) needs to act without reading prose: the module to patch, a stable check id, the requirement and its spec path, expected versus actual in the block's own port names, source anchors, a reproduction recipe, a confidence class, and drop history. Everything except `mechanism` is produced by code from run artifacts.

check_id.description: taxonomy id, optionally with the checker rule name: SCHED_004/activate_wrong_row, CSR_001/register_map, DATA_001/x_value

owner_module.description: the one block whose generator should be patched first

owner_candidates.description: other blocks the mechanism could sit in, in decreasing likelihood

confidence.description: confirmed: model-free evidence (X on a pin, an independent assertion) or read at source; observed: reported by a checker or predictor only

spec_ref.description: JSON path into the spec the requirement derives from

expected.description: at the first failing transaction, in the block's port vocabulary

detector.description: which check produced it: exact:<stage>, invariant:<stage>, assertion:<label>, x_value:<iface>

anchor.description: assignment sites of the failing transaction's ports in the owner's RTL, best first

mechanism.description: optional narrative; every cited line must exist and name a signal from the trace window, or the paragraph is dropped

related_manual_findings.description: hand-written outbox files that discuss the same defect
